preconditions.description: Input is an integer n between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() == 'NO') or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(1 <= int(line.strip()) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If 'NO' is printed, no further output is required. If 'YES' is printed, the following n lines must contain a permutation of [1, 2, ..., n] where the prefix product sequence is a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n-1].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i+1].strip()) not in [int(stdout.splitlines()[j+1].strip()) for j in range(i)] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the sequence must be a valid permutation of [1, 2, ..., n] with no duplicates.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(0 <= i < n for i in range(n)) and all(0 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i+1].strip()) <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the prefix product sequence must be a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n-1].
